strings.name: C. C. Wei
strings.role: Semiconductor engineer · TSMC chairman and CEO
strings.summary: Born in Nantou, Taiwan, Wei studied electrical engineering at National Chiao Tung University and earned a Yale doctorate. After semiconductor work in the United States and Singapore, he joined TSMC in 1998 and held manufacturing, business-development and co-CEO roles. He became CEO in 2018 and chairman in 2024. His management spans advanced-process production, customer collaboration and overseas expansion within the global foundry supply chain.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; reviewed November 15, 2026. This is not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Contributed to TSMC’s manufacturing technology, operations and business development, influencing advanced wafer foundry services and the global semiconductor supply chain.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Lugu Township, Nantou County, Taiwan; later raised in Taichung.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Electrical engineering bachelor’s and master’s degrees, National Chiao Tung University; electrical engineering doctorate, Yale (1985).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Manufacturing and operations
strings.highlights.h1.text: Moved from engineering and production into management, contributing to TSMC’s operations and business development.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Managing a wafer foundry
strings.highlights.h2.text: Served as co-CEO, CEO and chairman, managing customer service and global manufacturing expansion.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Adding the chairmanship
strings.timeline.t1.text: Succeeded as chairman while retaining the CEO role.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Becoming CEO
strings.timeline.t2.text: Became TSMC CEO after the end of its co-CEO arrangement.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becoming co-CEO
strings.timeline.t3.text: Jointly led the company with Mark Liu, taking on business and manufacturing responsibilities.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Becoming co-chief operating officer
strings.timeline.t4.text: Promoted to executive vice president and co-COO with broader operations duties.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Leading business development
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became senior vice president of business development, applying manufacturing experience to customers and growth.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joining TSMC
strings.timeline.t6.text: TSMC announced his appointment as vice president after work at TI and Chartered Semiconductor.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Earning a Yale doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed an electrical engineering doctorate and joined Texas Instruments for semiconductor work.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Nantou
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Lugu; later studied electrical engineering at National Chiao Tung University.
